name: Screw-down crown
summary: A winding crown that screws onto a tube on the case, so that the crown seals the case against water like a bolt in a gasket.
how: Cut a thread on the tube of the case and on the crown.
Fit a rubber gasket under the crown and press it as the crown screws down.
Seal the case back with a second gasket and a screw-on ring.

origin.note: A case maker patents the Oyster case with a screw-down crown; Rolex sells the watch under the name Oyster.

adoptions.via: The diver watch uses a screw-down crown and a screw-down case back to seal the case to 100 m.
